tagline: Global investment firm managing alternative assets across private equity, credit, and real assets
hero_kpi_rationale: KKR announced a stable dividend policy with annualized distribution of $0.78 per share, reflecting financial maturity and commitment to shareholders following years of capital growth in the private equity sector.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.explanation: Annual dividend per share paid to common shareholders
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share of $0.78, payable quarterly ($0.195 per quarter), announced February 5, 2026

kpis.name: Fee-related earnings
kpis.explanation: Recurring profits from management fees and ancillary fees, excluding realized performance revenues.
kpis.description: KKR's Fee Related Earnings reached $3.71 billion in 2025, up 13.7% versus 2024. This metric reflects the strength of the recurring revenue engine in the Asset Management segment.

kpis.name: Management fees
kpis.explanation: Fees collected by KKR for managing its funds, principal component of recurring revenues in the Asset Management segment.
kpis.description: Management fees advanced 18.5% in 2025 to reach $4.1 billion, driven by growth in assets under management. They represent the most predictable base of KKR revenues.

kpis.name: Insurance net investment income
kpis.explanation: Net revenues generated by the investment portfolio of the Insurance segment (Global Atlantic), before insurance costs.
kpis.description: Insurance segment net investment income reached $7.22 billion in 2025, up 14.2% versus 2024. It reflects the scaling up of KKR's insurance balance sheet through Global Atlantic.

kpis.name: Total segment earnings
kpis.explanation: Sum of operating profits across all segments (Asset Management, Insurance, Strategic Holdings), non-GAAP measure of KKR's overall profitability.
kpis.description: Total segment earnings reached $5.89 billion in 2025, up 6.9% versus 2024. This metric aggregates operating performance across KKR's three strategic pillars.

kpis.name: Insurance segment assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets allocated to KKR's Insurance segment, reflecting the size of Global Atlantic's balance sheet.
kpis.description: Insurance segment assets reached $272.6 billion as of December 31, 2025, up 11.9% versus end of 2024. They represent the substantial majority of KKR's total assets and demonstrate Global Atlantic's scaling.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends across the last 7 reported fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.185 last year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow across the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.769 billion last year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated across the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 32.4% last year.
